name: PB_InteractCooldownStep
formula: lin 0.016666668 (interaction manager update 0x1408266D0: the cooldowns [0xE0], [0xD4], [0xCC] and [0xC4] (0.3 s after an interaction such as grabbing a block) each -= xmm6 = 1/60 s per frame; xmm6 has no other use before it is overwritten in the candidate loop)

name: PB_BlockNavPullLerp
formula: lerp 0.05 (BehaviorMovableBlock update 0x14043DC60, state 0: pos.xz += (nearest point of its area - pos).xz * 0.05 per frame, VecScale at 0x14043E45A)

name: PB_BlockFallExact
instruction: subss xmm1, xmm0 ; movss xmm0, dword ptr [rdi + 0xb20] ; subss xmm6, xmm0 ; movss dword ptr [rdi + 0xb24], xmm1 ; addss xmm1, dword ptr [rdi + 0x54] ; movss dword ptr [rdi + 0x54], xmm1
formula: BehaviorMovableBlock fall (state 1, phase 1): vy [0xB24] -= g with g = GetDelta/300 (xmm0), then pos.y += vy once per frame without the delta (2.4x too fast at 144 fps). 60 Hz per tick: v -= G; y += v (G = D/300). Exact over e ticks: y += e*v_new - g*(1-e)/2. Cave at e < 1: g -> xmm2; the first 24 bytes; xmm1 = e*vy - g*(1-e)/2; the last 10 bytes. xmm2/xmm3 dead (calls or reloads follow on every path).

name: PB_BlockMovedKeep
formula: BehaviorMovableBlock slot 7 (0x14043DC10) clears the moved flag [0x978] every frame; the push (0x1404C282F) sets it after moving the block and only the block update (slot 8, 0x14043E4B2) applies a move to bones and collision. If the block updates before the player in a frame, the flag is cleared before it is ever applied and the block never moves visibly. Cave: keep the flag (jmp site+10); PB_BlockMovedConsume clears it once applied.

name: PB_BlockMovedConsume
formula: End of the block update: if the moved flag is set, the block bones and collision are rebuilt (vfunc +8). Cave: cmp dword [rdi+0x978],0; je done; mov dword [rdi+0x978],0 (flags unchanged, ZF stays 0); done: jmp site+7 (the je that follows reads ZF).

name: PB_PushMoveThreshold
formula: lin 0.0001 (push state 0x1404C2130: the player displacement this frame must exceed 0.0001 (twice, xmm7) before the block may move; otherwise the displacement is discarded. A fixed per-frame amount is a speed threshold that rises with the frame rate; 0.0001*e keeps the 60 FPS speed threshold)
